title: From Approximation Rates to Loss-Landscape Barrier Decay in Shallow ReLU Networks
abstract: arXiv:2602.17596v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study pathwise connectivity of sublevel sets for one-hidden-layer ReLU networks with constrained first-layer weights and an $\ell_1$ penalty on the output layer. The data term is assumed convex and globally Lipschitz in the scalar logit. We first give a finite-width construction that connects any two points of a common sublevel through a path controlled by a loss-consistent compression functional and a first-order perturbation term. The proof replaces the quadratic perturbation estimate in the Freeman--Bruna mechanism by a direct Lipschitz bound. Positive homogeneity is then used in a direction that is compatible with the penalty: every active atom is moved monotonically from the unit ball to the unit sphere while its output coefficient is reduced. Sphere covering and cluster merging consequently give $O(m^{-1/(n-1)})$ fixed-level thickening for $n\ge2$, while the one-dimensional two-ray dictionary gives exact connectivity for eve

translated_title: 从逼近率到浅层ReLU网络中损失景观屏障的衰减
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有约束第一层权重和输出层$\ell_1$惩罚的单隐层ReLU网络的子水平集的路径连通性。数据项被假定为凸的，并且在标量logit上是全局Lipschitz的。我们首先给出一个有限宽度构造，通过由损失一致的压缩泛函和一阶扰动项控制的路径，连接同一子水平的任意两点。该证明将Freeman-Bruna机制中的二次扰动估计替换为直接的Lipschitz界。然后，正齐次性被用于与惩罚兼容的方向：每个活跃原子从单位球单调移动到单位球面，同时其输出系数被减小。球覆盖和簇合并因此为$n\ge2$提供了$O(m^{-1/(n-1)})$的固定水平增厚，而一维双射线字典给出了对偶情况的精确连通性。
tldr: 本文通过直接Lipschitz界和正齐次性方向调整，建立了浅层ReLU网络子水平集的路径连通性，并证明了固定水平增厚率$O(m^{-1/(n-1)})$，为损失景观屏障衰减提供了新机制。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes pathwise connectivity of sublevel sets in shallow ReLU networks via a direct Lipschitz bound and positive homogeneity, achieving $O(m^{-1/(n-1)})$ fixed-level thickening for loss-landscape barrier decay.
